prompt:
The same Berlin bicycle lane, seen from the side, wide, vertical frame. Two
men face each other, and BOTH ARE ON THE RED STRIP. On the left the young man
in the navy blue polo shirt, beige chinos and white leather sneakers stands
with both feet planted on the red paint, well inside it, turned to his right
toward the other man; the grey pavement slabs are further left and empty. On the right a man in his forties in a
BRIGHT YELLOW waterproof jacket has stopped his dark grey bicycle across the
lane and stands over it with one foot flat on the ground, facing him, one
hand on the handlebars. There is a pace of empty red strip between them. The
pale cream facade with its tall stone-framed windows runs along behind, with
three or four black city bicycles leaning against the wall, well spaced. The lane is clear in both directions. Grey
pavement slabs to the left, a granite kerb. Daylight, overcast and flat.
